about: Contacts are chosen, not rolled: the counts table gives how many. These are the types the Players' Book lists, with what Appendix C says each provides.

contacts.name: Medicine
contacts.summary: Medical advice and care, free or cheap.

contacts.name: Law
contacts.summary: Legal advice free, representation at a reduced fee.

contacts.name: Law Enforcement
contacts.summary: From a patrolman to a commissioner; police resources.

contacts.name: Military
contacts.summary: Armed forces of any rank; up to Amazing resources.

contacts.name: Business World
contacts.summary: Business and finance; up to Incredible resources.

contacts.name: Journalism
contacts.summary: Poor resources but Remarkable knowledge of their beat.

contacts.name: Crime
contacts.summary: From a street snitch to a crime boss; risky to rely on.

contacts.name: Engineering
contacts.summary: Someone who builds things and can help build devices.

contacts.name: Psychiatry
contacts.summary: A psychiatrist or analyst.

contacts.name: Espionage
contacts.summary: An intelligence agency; information and equipment, favors owed.

contacts.name: Hero Group
contacts.summary: A superhero team's help, gear and headquarters, and its enemies.

contacts.name: Artist/Performer
contacts.summary: Someone in acting or performing.

contacts.name: Chemistry
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Biology
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Geology
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Genetics
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Archaeology
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Physics
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Computers
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Electronics
contacts.summary: A scientist with that Talent and at least Excellent Reason.

contacts.name: Local
contacts.summary: A local official; neighborhood information.

contacts.name: State
contacts.summary: State government; up to Remarkable resources.

contacts.name: National
contacts.summary: National government; up to Monstrous, and favors get called in.

contacts.name: Other National
contacts.summary: Another nation's government, friend or foe.

contacts.name: International
contacts.summary: The UN or similar; up to Monstrous resources.

contacts.name: Planetary
contacts.summary: Aliens only: another world's people or rulers.

contacts.name: Religion
contacts.summary: Named in the Players' Book's list of Contact types, not described in Appendix C.

contacts.name: Mystic Arts
contacts.summary: Someone aware of extradimensional powers.

contacts.name: Occult Lore
contacts.summary: A scholar of the occult with Remarkable Reason in it.

contacts.name: Mythology
contacts.summary: A scholar of one pantheon of gods.
